# Version 4.152.1
> **Glyph atlas correctness** · Released September 9, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.201/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.1 prevents partial glyph-atlas updates from reusing evicted glyph locations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Glyph-atlas generation recorded only for complete updates** — Ganesh and Graphite no longer treat a partial glyph-vector update as proof that all earlier atlas locations are current. ([#5047](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5047))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.201

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
